unit.why: A short anecdote: a slaughterer asks the tsaddik whether to slaughter his cattle for the holiday, and the rebbe identifies from written descriptions which animals are kosher, which are treif, and which will raise a doubtful question.

stories.start_quote: פ"א בא הטבח ושאל עצה כדת
stories.end_quote: כי תורה היא ולא בשמים היא
stories.summary_en: A butcher afraid of finding treif animals asks the holy rabbi whether to slaughter them for the festival; from written descriptions of each animal the rabbi tells which is kosher, which treif, and which will raise a question he leaves to the halakhic decisor, since 'the Torah is not in heaven'.
